documents.notes: 'First-Year Applicants' (the first-year international URL redirects here), Step 3 'Review and Submit Required Application Materials'. The School Report is submitted by the counselor with the transcript. Need-aware for international students; the CSS Profile is a financial-aid form, not drafted. The page states no academic year.

items.quote: Your high school should submit an official high school transcript that includes grades for all completed courses and lists in-progress courses.
The counselor recommendation highlights your accomplishments within the context of your high school.
You're required to submit two teacher recommendations, which should highlight your academic strengths and contributions in the classroom.
As part of your Common Application, you'll be asked to fill out the Cornell University supplement, which includes the college- or school-specific essay(s) you'll need to answer.
You're required to submit SAT or ACT scores when applying to Cornell.

If you're an international applicant, you must also demonstrate English language proficiency and may be required to submit scores from an approved English language proficiency exam as part of your application.
items.condition: international applicant whose English proficiency is not demonstrated by the other accepted criteria
